name: Okra
summary: In Westfall, Okra grows in the plots at Saldean's Farm. Homesteaders prize the crop, and it thickens the stews that feed them.

sections.title: A Staple of Saldean's Farm
sections.body: Saldean's Farm still yields vegetables while much of Westfall lies fallow under threat from Defias outlaws and rogue harvest golem attacks. Okra grows in the tilled plots around the farm. The crop persists through the harsh conditions, nourishing local homesteaders when trade and supplies from Stormwind run dry.

sections.title: Westfall Stew
sections.body: Salma Saldean's famous Westfall Stew depends on okra. She combines sliced pods with whatever meat settlers can hunt across the dusty plains, including vulture flesh, goretusk snouts, and coastal murloc eyes. The pods break down in the heat, thickening thin broth into a filling, restorative meal. For settlers clinging to their homesteads, fresh okra turns sparse scavenging into a hot supper.

faq.q: Where does okra grow in Westfall?
faq.answer: Okra grows in the tilled plots at Saldean's Farm along Westfall's central road. The green plants thrive in furrows near Farmer Saldean's homestead.
Salma Saldean gathers okra at Saldean's Farm for her signature Westfall Stew. Its natural starch thickens the broth, blending vulture meat, boar snouts, and murloc eyes into a hearty meal.

faq.q: Why is okra important to the Saldeans?
faq.answer: With trade disrupted and little aid from the kingdom, homesteaders rely on what they can grow and hunt. Okra is one of the few cultivated crops remaining at Saldean's Farm, helping feed the family and passing travelers.

angles.text: A wandering cook knows a good stew needs more than raw meat. Okra gives tough wilderness forage the starch and body of a hot meal.
Stormwind nobles dine on imported meats, while frontier Alliance homesteaders cultivate stubborn crops like okra amid Westfall's ruins.
